meta.description:
When Paul shares a client workbook, update that client's dashboard from it.

What it does NOT do, on purpose: wire up a client the app has never seen. Everything else here is checked against the workbook — every figure, and where each figure sits. Which portal login a business belongs to is not checkable, and getting it wrong shows one client another's books, so a new client stops at a message asking a person to finish it.

Before this runs:
  • Google Drive credential — the account Paul shares with
  • GitHub credential — write access to teDdyMucho/taxnitro
  • Slack credential, and a channel id in the three notify nodes
  • FTG_CONVERTER_URL and FTG_CONVERTER_TOKEN set on this n8n instance,
    pointing at automation/service deployed on Railway
